interpretation: Three fixed-seed repetitions on four known tasks, with all failures and inactive controls retained. Descriptive ranges and standard deviations are conditional on these tasks and seeds. No random-task sampling, confidence-interval coverage, statistical noninferiority or unseen-task transfer is established.
